净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Combines drawdown depth normalized by ATR with a volatility expansion ratio as an adaptive weight. During volatile market phases (high ATR expansion), the drawdown signal is amplified, reflecting faster mean-reversion expectations. The cross-sectional rank is retained to capture relative severity across stocks.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

depth = (close / ts_max(63, close) - 1) * -1; normalized = depth / ts_mean(63, TR); exp_ratio = ts_mean(20, TR) / ts_mean(120, TR); factor = normalized * clip(exp_ratio, 0.5, 2.0)
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

depth = (close / ts_max(63, close) - 1) * -1; normalized = depth / ts_mean(63, TR); exp_ratio = ts_mean(20, TR) / ts_mean(120, TR); factor = normalized * clip(exp_ratio, 0.5, 2.0)

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(divide(multiply(subtract(divide(close, ts_max(close, 63)), 1), -1), ts_mean(TR, 63)), clip(divide(ts_mean(TR, 20), ts_mean(TR, 120)), 0.5, 2))
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(multiply(subtract(divide(close, ts_max(close, 63)), 1), -1), ts_mean(TR, 63))
  3. 3. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(subtract(divide(close, ts_max(close, 63)), 1), -1)
  4. 4. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(divide(close, ts_max(close, 63)), 1)
  5. 5. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(close, ts_max(close, 63))
  6. 6. ts_max —— 过去 N 天滚动最大值
    ts_max(close, 63)
  7. 7. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(TR, 63)
  8. 8. clip —— 裁剪到区间[下限,上限]
    clip(divide(ts_mean(TR, 20), ts_mean(TR, 120)), 0.5, 2)
  9. 9. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(ts_mean(TR, 20), ts_mean(TR, 120))
  10. 10. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(TR, 20)
  11. 11. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(TR, 120)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
TR真实波幅（true_range 简称，max(H-L,|H-C|,|L-C|)）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 peak：close.滚动窗口(63, min_periods=63).max()
  2. 计算 dd：(close - peak) / peak
  3. 计算 depth：(-dd)
  4. 计算 high_low：high - low
  5. 计算 high_close：(high - close.shift(1)).abs()
  6. 计算 low_close：(low - close.shift(1)).abs()
  7. 计算 tr：pd.concat([high_low, high_close, low_close, axis=1).max(axis=1)
  8. 计算 atr_63：tr.滚动窗口(63, min_periods=63).mean()
  9. 计算 atr_20：tr.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  10. 计算 atr_120：tr.滚动窗口(120, min_periods=120).mean()
  11. 计算 exp_ratio：atr_20 / atr_120
  12. 计算 exp_ratio_clipped：np.clip(exp_ratio, 0.5, 2.0)
  13. 计算 normalized_depth：depth / atr_63
  14. 计算 factor：normalized_depth * exp_ratio_clipped
  15. 计算 factor：factor
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_depth_atr_adaptive(df): df_copy = df.copy() peak = df_copy["close"].rolling(63, min_periods=63).max() dd = (df_copy["close"] - peak) / peak depth = (-dd) high_low = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"] high_close = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["close"].shift(1)).abs() low_close = (df_copy["low"] - df_copy["close"].shift(1)).abs() tr = pd.concat([high_low, high_close, low_close], axis=1).max(axis=1) atr_63 = tr.rolling(63, min_periods=63).mean() atr_20 = tr.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() atr_120 = tr.rolling(120, min_periods=120).mean() exp_ratio = atr_20 / atr_120.replace(0, np.nan) exp_ratio_clipped = np.clip(exp_ratio, 0.5, 2.0) normalized_depth = depth / atr_63.replace(0, np.nan) factor = normalized_depth * exp_ratio_clipped factor = factor.fillna(0) df_copy["factor_drawdown_depth_atr_adaptive"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_drawdown_depth_atr_adaptive"]
